productsAndServices.description: A customizable platform for deploying Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI with local or cloud LLMs, secure vector storage, and intelligent data orchestration.

productsAndServices.description: A solution that connects local file systems to AI and chatbot platforms, enabling real-time, secure, conversational AI access without workflow changes.
productsAndServices.name: AI Enabler

productsAndServices.description: A platform that controls and filters data accessible to AI systems, enforcing compliance through sensitive data filtering, anonymization, and permission checks.
productsAndServices.name: AI Governance

productsAndServices.description: Integration with existing file servers to enhance file management, security, and accessibility without altering current infrastructure or permissions.
productsAndServices.name: File Server Integration
